chunks: And he, peace be upon him, ruled concerning the people of the desert that they should not withhold surplus water, nor sell surplus pasture.

key_terms.أَهْلِ اَلْبَوَادِي: the people of the desert or desert-dwelling communities
key_terms.فَضْلَ اَلْكَلَإِ: surplus pasture or excess grazing land/forage
key_terms.فَضْلَ مَاءٍ: surplus water beyond one’s own need
key_terms.يَمْنَعُوا: to withhold or prevent others from access

ai.seo_question: What did the Imam عليه السلام rule about surplus water and pasture among the people of the desert?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling of the Imam عليه السلام regarding shared natural resources among desert-dwellers. It prohibits withholding excess water and selling excess pasture, emphasizing fair access and the rights of others in necessities.
